metadata.short_desc: Schedule QQ Zone posts with AI-written captions and draft approval.
metadata.desc: A lightweight QQ Zone (Qzone) plugin for AstrBot. It reuses the OneBot login session to fetch cookies automatically, and supports manual or scheduled posts with images, AI-written captions, an integrated daily-life schedule, optional reading/liking/commenting on friends' posts (read-only by default), and a draft-approval mode.
